title: ALL FINITE CARDINALITIES OF THE HYPERSPACE OF REGULAR SUBCONTINUA
summary: For a metric continuum X, let D(X) be the family of subcontinua A of X with A = cl_X int_X A. Ordõnez asked which finite numbers occur as |D(X)|. Camargo, Ordõnez and Ramírez excluded 2, 4, 5, 8, 9 and asked whether every k ≥ 256 occurs. We prove that a positive integer k equals |D(X)| for some metric continuum X if and only if k not in {2, 4, 5, 8, 9, 16}. The finite cardinalities of D(X) are exactly the numbers of vertex sets inducing connected subgraphs of finite connected graphs; every finite connected graph is realized by copies of the Knaster continuum glued at points.
